answers.core:
I'm not even certain if someone could make a plugin to do that. I mean, its possible as Godot is open source and everything, but still, I have no idea how someone might go around doing that.

Also, I'll admit this is my first feature suggestion and its kind of a simple request (in thinking of what is wanted, not in implementing it) so I'm not too certain this is was written well, or just made well in general.
answers.workaround: You can give a node a class name, followed by making a script that extends that class, and connect it when needed, although it isn't convenient, and I was told that the _ready() function will not work here. And I for example, am having a hard time figuring out how to connect another script to any node in general.
